First observe whether you can keep original values and numbers, find time conflicts on the same resource and leave them pending, and neither delete bookings nor fill in unknowns on your own. How does the handover distinguish planned from actually completed status?
Preparation | Booking and scheduling | Confirm the agreed time, location, and passenger needs, obtain the actual arrangement information, and refer unclear needs to the responsible person.
Inspection | Vehicle, equipment, and abnormalities | Inspect the vehicle and safety equipment per professional training and report items needing repair; the paper page does not teach fault repair.
Driving | Pickup per agreement and rules | Pick up and drop off per traffic safety rules, and do not ignore road, vehicle, or safety status for a time slot or pressure.
Service | Boarding, alighting, and special needs | Assist passengers and luggage, with special equipment used per approved training; transport service does not confer medical or emergency authority.
Communication | Dispatch changes and delays | Explain actual exceptions, delays, or schedule changes, and check the responsibility process without fabricating client confirmation.
Records | Trip and cost reports | Record actual counts, hours, mileage, energy, or costs, keeping the plan and completion statuses separate.

description.text: Shuttle drivers and chauffeurs drive vehicles to transport passengers per a prior plan or schedule, possibly for a fee; this includes non-emergency medical transport and hearse driving, but does not thereby confer medical or emergency service qualification. This page fixes O*NET-SOC53-3053.00 to the current Shuttle Drivers and Chauffeurs, with the old URL name retained; on-demand fare taxi 53-3054 is listed separately. Actual business first separates unit self-use pickup, commercial shuttle and charter, or taxi bookings, then checks personnel permitted class, vehicle operation, permitted areas, and safety training; paper schedule checking grants no driving or operating qualification.
